impl fastdata {
    const BUCKETS: [i32; 4] = [
        1, 2, 0, 3

    const ENTRIES: [E; 3] = [
        E { next: -1, key: u8::MIN }, E { next: -1, key: 1 }, E { next: -1, key: u8::MAX }

    #[inline(always)]
    fn get_hash(value: u8) -> u64 {

    pub fn keys() -> impl Iterator<Item = u8> {
        Self::ENTRIES.iter().map(|entry| entry.key)

    #[must_use]
    pub fn contains(key: u8) -> bool {

        let hash = Self::get_hash(key);
        let index = hash % 4u64;
        let mut i: i32 = (Self::BUCKETS[index as usize] as i32) - 1;

        while i >= 0 {
            let entry = &Self::ENTRIES[i as usize];
            if entry.key == key {
                return true;
            }
            i = entry.next as i32;
        }

        false
    }

    pub const MAX_KEY: u8 = u8::MAX;
